Class PerishableProduct

java.lang.Object
learn.inventory.model.Product
learn.inventory.model.PerishableProduct
All Implemented Interfaces:
Expirable
public class PerishableProduct extends Product implements Expirable
Represents an inventory product with an expiration date.

This class inherits the shared product information and stock behavior from Product. It also implements Expirable so it can report its expiration date and whether it has expired.
